description: Package C6: Dry-Run Correction Manifest for Public and Seeded Records

corrections.oldBasis: Early unverified prompt output hallucinated 'near-future Brooklyn' as the setting.
corrections.newSourceBasis: Variety announcement ('Chaz Bottoms Unveils Junichiro Jackson Proof of Concept') and TeamTO studio release confirm the setting is an anime-inspired futuristic Chicago scored to Chicago hip-hop.
corrections.proposedChange: Reconcile all setting and storyworld references from Brooklyn to Chicago; retain creator attribution to Chaz Bottoms (CBC Studios) and co-producer TeamTO; clarify actual stage (pilot complete, seeking series financing) and linear vs SVOD development uncertainty.
corrections.rollbackMethod: Revert card JSON fixtures to git commit 35de35e or update publishedCardId pointer in Firestore.

corrections.oldBasis: Title-word association hallucinated a bicycle collective repairing discarded bicycles in Milwaukee.
corrections.newSourceBasis: Verified reporting from Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, Racine County Eye, WUWM 89.7, and PBS Wisconsin confirming CYCLE is a documentary directed by Laura Dyan Kezman (Lion Art Media) investigating the fatal police shooting of 18-year-old Ty'Rese West in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin.
corrections.proposedChange: Replace all bicycle collective summaries with verified documentary details: Director Laura Dyan Kezman, producers Vianca Fuster & Michelle Craig, subject Ty'Rese West, investigative police accountability focus, and community impact screening pathways.
corrections.rollbackMethod: Revert firestore-repo.ts seed records or bump card version to card-cycle-v2 with immutable historical preservation of v1.

corrections.inaccurateField: Missing canonical seed record in dataRepo; conflation of pilot crowdfunding with full series budget
corrections.oldBasis: Vampair existed in YouTube comment analysis tests and client components, but had no canonical Scout Card in dataRepo.
corrections.newSourceBasis: Kickstarter & Indiegogo campaigns ($286,000+ raised for 11-minute musical pilot) and Animation Magazine reporting on Daria Cohen's independent gothic musical series.
corrections.proposedChange: Seed canonical Project ('proj-vampair') and Scout Card ('card-vampair-v1') with creator Daria Cohen; explicitly distinguish the $286k pilot campaign funding from the $1.5M - $2M full episodic series budget; verify 100% creator IP retention.
corrections.rollbackMethod: Remove p6/c6 from seedInitialData in firestore-repo.ts.
